Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional rechargeable reading light with a secure clip, uneven brightness, and a charging port hidden under a stiff cover. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I bought this rechargeable reading light for late-night chapters, and the secure clip grips my hardcover perfectly. But the brightness is uneven—bright at one end, dim at the other. Also, the charging port hides under a stiff cover that’s a real pain to pry open.
